title: WhatsApp starts suggesting your latest photos and videos right in your chats
description: WhatsApp already suggests stickers above the keyboard on Android based on the emojis you type, and now it's taking that suggestion system a step further. Media suggestions are rolling out to some users on both Android and iOS with the latest versions of the app. When you open a chat, WhatsApp can now offer to send whatever you most recently added to your gallery. There are two ways this can show up, and you'll only get one of them. In the first, a toast pops up above the chat bar as soon as you open a conversation. title: Samsung Galaxy A38's battery capacity leaks, and it's finally an upgrade
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy A37 back in March, and we've already heard that its successor will keep the same camera setup. Today, a new report from the same source claims the Galaxy A38 will get an upgrade over its predecessor after all, but in a different area: the battery capacity. The Galaxy A38 will allegedly have a battery with a rated capacity of 5,882 mAh, which should mean a typical capacity of 6,000 mAh. That's 20% more than the 5,000 mAh battery in the A37. description: Redmi launched the Turbo 5 Max back in January, and its successor's design has already leaked. It's said to use LIPO packaging, which shrinks the bottom bezel so it matches the others, leaving bezels of around 1mm on all four sides. description: Quick Share has come a long way over the past year. It started working with Apple's AirDrop on Pixels, then that support began spreading to other Android phones, and in August Google launched Tap to Share. At its Android Dev Summit, Google announced a Quick Share SDK that will be released in the first half of 2027, along with a Quick Share iOS SDK for iPhone apps. description: It has been months since Xiaomi launched the 46mm Xiaomi Watch S5. Now, a leak reveals the specs of an upcoming 41mm version of the watch.
